parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: false, message: 'Invalid payload. user_id, actual_calories, and meal_type are required.' }) }}

parameters.update: ={{ JSON.stringify({ $set: { target_calories: $json.db_updates[0].update.$set.target_calories, adjusted_by_uc42: true, adjusted_at: new Date().toISOString() } }) }}

parameters.query: ={{ JSON.stringify({ user_id: $json.user_id, date: { $gte: { $date: new Date($json.next_day_payload.target_date).toISOString() }, $lt: { $date: new Date(new Date($json.next_day_payload.target_date).getTime() + 86400000).toISOString() } } }) }}

parameters.update: ={{ JSON.stringify({ $inc: { target_calories: $json.next_day_payload.delta_cal_carry, 'macro_targets.protein': $json.next_day_payload.proteinDelta, 'macro_targets.carbs': $json.next_day_payload.carbsDelta, 'macro_targets.fat': $json.next_day_payload.fatDelta }, $set: { adjusted_by_uc42: true, adjusted_at: new Date().toISOString() } }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ event: 'macro_rings_update', room: $('Calorie Adaptive Redistribution').first().json.user_id, payload: { route: $('Calorie Adaptive Redistribution').first().json.route, delta_cal: $('Calorie Adaptive Redistribution').first().json.delta_cal, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() } }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, route: $('Calorie Adaptive Redistribution').first().json.route, delta_cal: $('Calorie Adaptive Redistribution').first().json.delta_cal, update_count: ($('Calorie Adaptive Redistribution').first().json.update_payload || []).length, message: 'Calorie targets auto-adjusted successfully.' }) }}
